fields.title: Homepage
fields.description:
Portfolio - Dominic Seel

A comprehensive monorepo for my personal portfolio, engineered with a robust Python/Django backend and a dynamic React/TypeScript frontend.This project showcases modern web development practices, leveraging Nx for efficient monorepo management.

Key Architecture

  • Backend: Powered by Django (Python 3.13), ensuring high performance and security. Code quality is strictly maintained via Ruff and tested with pytest.
  • Frontend: Built with React 19 and TypeScript, bundled with Vite for lightning-fast development. Includes extensive testing with Vitest (unit) and Playwright (E2E).
  • Infrastructure: Dockerized environment running on Ubuntu, with CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions.

Core Technologies

Python, Django, Node.js, React, TypeScript, Redux, Sass, PostgreSQL, and Docker.
